primaryChecks.text: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

context.text: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.
while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

primaryChecks.text: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

context.text: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.
They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.
